categories.main_business_segments: Nanya PCB primarily engages in the manufacturing and sales of printed circuit boards (PCBs), including general PCBs and high-end IC substrates. The company focuses on high-value products such as IC substrates for AI servers, high-speed switches, and system-in-package (SiP) substrates for mobile and wearable devices. It also serves markets including cloud computing, edge computing, high-end networking, and consumer electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including high-density interconnect (HDI) boards, multi-layer boards, and fine-line circuitry. For IC substrates, it employs PP and ABF substrate technologies with focus on fine lines, microvias, thin and high-layer designs. Production methods include mechanical and laser drilling, plating, lamination, and surface treatments, with ongoing digital optimization and AI-driven process improvements to enhance yield and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Nanya PCB serves major global customers in the computer, communication, networking, consumer electronics, and automotive sectors. Key markets include the United States, Japan, Europe, Taiwan, China, and South Korea. Its products are used in servers, AI computing, 5G networking equipment, high-end graphics cards, mobile devices, and automotive electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan and China with manufacturing facilities in Taoyuan, New Taipei City, and overseas subsidiaries in Hong Kong, China, and the United States. Sales and customer bases are global, with significant revenue from Taiwan, China, the US, South Korea, Japan, and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanya PCB operates in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, producing printed circuit boards and IC substrates that serve as essential components for semiconductor packaging and electronic device assembly. It benefits from vertical integration within the Formosa Plastics Group, securing upstream raw materials like copper foil and epoxy resin.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in high-value IC substrates for AI servers, high-speed networking, and system-in-package technologies. It invests in digital transformation, AI-enhanced manufacturing, and process optimization to improve product quality and operational efficiency. Sustainability and ESG initiatives, including energy saving, carbon reduction, and green energy adoption, are integral to its strategic roadmap.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of printed circuit boards and IC substrates to global electronics manufacturers. The company’s income derives from product sales, with a focus on high-margin, high-technology products. It also benefits from government subsidies and foreign exchange gains as supplementary income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nanya PCB is positioned as a leading global PCB and IC substrate manufacturer with strong technical capabilities and a comprehensive product portfolio. It competes with other major PCB suppliers in Taiwan and China, leveraging its integration with Formosa Plastics Group for stable raw material supply and cost advantages. The company emphasizes quality, technology leadership, and customer collaboration to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$32.28 billion, a 23.59% decrease from the previous year, with a pre-tax profit of NT$163 million. The decline was mainly due to weakened demand in networking and consumer electronics sectors. Despite short-term revenue contraction, the company continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D, aiming for growth driven by AI, cloud computing, and 5G markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nanya PCB offers high-quality, technologically advanced PCB and IC substrate products tailored for high-performance computing, AI, and networking applications. Its value proposition includes strong vertical integration ensuring stable raw material supply, advanced manufacturing capabilities with AI and digital optimization, and close collaboration with leading global customers to develop customized, high-value solutions. The company also emphasizes sustainability and corporate social responsibility as part of its brand differentiation.
